messages:
nina (partnerships): FYI — Nimbus Cloud + CoreWare asked to co-host a short technical session at ScaleSummit. They want a hardware + marketplace angle. Need to lock speaker list, demo flow, and swag by Mon so marketing can launch. Quick volunteers for a 15m planning call?

li (eng): I can. two quick Qs: are we demoing on partner hardware or our hosted endpoint? and which precision are we showing (fp16/int8)?

rob (solutions): partners prefer an on-prem appliance demo (CoreWare box) and a fallback deploy from Nimbus Marketplace. Thinking 8m device demo, 8m marketplace deploy, 10m Q&A. I'll draft the runbook.

cam (marketing): promo schedule: assets due Mon 10am — headshots, 40-60w bios, session blurb (1-2 lines). Also confirm recording + distribution rights. Swag: budget ~ $1.5k. Options: stickers + branded notebooks, or stickers + portable chargers. Thoughts?

tara (ops): chargers more expensive to ship; notebooks fit budget better. We can do 180 stickers + 80 notebooks within $1.5k, estimated ship lead 8-11 business days after PO.

nina (partnerships): @rob please confirm demo commands and infra needs so @li can size. legal-review-bot, can you start review for announcement copy once I drop it here?

legal-review-bot: review queued. ETA 48 hours after copy is attached. Please include speaker list and recording permissions.

li (eng): infra note: for on-appliance demo we only need a local gateway + 1 A10G-equivalent to host model for live audience. Marketplace demo needs 1 small cluster instance (A30 or 1x A10G) for reliability. Also require a short-lived demo API key and an allowlist entry for the rehearsal page.

rob (solutions): draft runbook:
```
00:00 intros (3m)
03:00 CoreWare appliance demo - low-latency Q&A (8m)
11:30 Nimbus Marketplace deploy - one-click deploy + Redwood call (8m)
19:30 partner integration highlight (4m)
23:30 live Q&A (10m)
```
I'll upload the runbook and attach demo snippets. Example snippet for marketplace: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.nimbus.market/v1/deploy -H "Authorization: Bearer DEMO_KEY" -d '{"package":"redwood-edge","region":"us-east-1"}'
```

cam (marketing): rehearsal: can we do Tue 9:30-10:30 PT? calendar-bot please propose.

calendar-bot: tentative invite created for Tue 9:30-10:30 PT. Partners and internal presenters invited. RSVP by EOD Mon.

tara (ops): swag ops: will finalize notebooks + stickers unless partners request chargers and cover extra shipping. Need final SKU by Mon to meet PO timeline.

nina (partnerships): action items: rob -> runbook + partner diagrams (due Mon), li -> infra sizing + demo keys (due Mon), cam -> landing copy + bios + logo guidelines request (due Mon), tara -> finalize swag SKU & PO (due Mon), legal-review-bot -> return comments (ETA 48h). I'll follow up with Nimbus/CoreWare for speaker confirmations.

cam (marketing): partners please send 1-slide architecture SVG and confirm logo lockups. If they want gated on-demand video, flag now.

rob (solutions): will request diagrams and confirm gated vs open recording with partners.

nina (partnerships): great — unless anyone objects I'll convert this thread into a tracking doc and set up weekly check-ins until the event. thanks all :handshake:
